facts.statement: CapCut Online lets users edit media on a timeline, including trimming and splitting clips.

localized_statement.en-US: Edit clips on CapCut Online's timeline by trimming or splitting them.
localized_statement.es-ES: Edita clips en la línea de tiempo de CapCut Online, por ejemplo, recortándolos o dividiéndolos.

facts.source_quote: Drag and drop your media files to the editing timeline. You can trim, crop, split, reverse, or mirror clips.
facts.source_title: Free Online Video Editor: Create Videos Easily | CapCut
facts.availability_note: Editing options and export settings may vary by account, plan, region, and product version.

facts.statement: CapCut Auto Captions generates subtitles from spoken audio in a video; users can edit caption text, timing, or style after generation.

localized_statement.en-US: Auto Captions turns speech in a video into subtitles that you can review and edit.
localized_statement.es-ES: Los subtítulos automáticos convierten la voz del vídeo en subtítulos que puedes revisar y editar.

facts.source_quote: uses AI speech-to-text technology to automatically generate subtitles from spoken audio in your video. ... Edit timing, text, or style as needed after generation.
facts.source_title: How do I recognise subtitles? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: The help page describes Web, Desktop, and Mobile as of January 2026; advanced functions depend on region and app version. Review generated captions before publication.

facts.statement: CapCut International can create bilingual subtitles by recognizing and translating speech in a video.

localized_statement.en-US: CapCut can recognize speech and translate it into bilingual subtitles.
localized_statement.es-ES: CapCut puede reconocer la voz y traducirla para crear subtítulos bilingües.

facts.source_quote: CapCut International supports one-click generation of bilingual subtitles, automatically recognizing and translating spoken content in videos without manual input.
facts.source_title: How to Recognize Bilingual Subtitles? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: Check the target language, account, region, and current product version before promising a specific translation workflow. Human review of translated text is recommended.

facts.statement: In CapCut Web, users can enter text, choose a voice and language, and generate speech audio.

localized_statement.en-US: Enter text in CapCut Web, choose a voice and language, and generate speech audio.
localized_statement.es-ES: Introduce texto en CapCut Web, elige una voz y un idioma y genera audio de voz.

facts.source_quote: Enter the text you want to convert to speech. ... Choose a voice and language. ... Click Generate and wait for the audio to appear.
facts.source_title: Why Is the Text-to-Speech Feature Not Working in CapCut? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: Voice and language availability may vary. The help page notes that network problems or unsupported text, languages, or voices can interrupt generation.

facts.statement: CapCut Web supports importing external SRT subtitle files.

localized_statement.en-US: Import an SRT subtitle file into CapCut Web.
localized_statement.es-ES: Importa un archivo de subtítulos SRT en CapCut Web.

facts.source_quote: Choose a .srt file from your device. TXT files are not supported on Web—only SRT.
facts.source_title: How Do I Import Subtitles? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: Direct subtitle-file import is described for Web and Desktop, not Mobile, as of 2026. Validate SRT timing and encoding before import.

facts.statement: In CapCut Web, users select Auto Captions > Recognise, choose a language, and click Generate to create captions.

localized_statement.en-US: In CapCut Web, choose Auto Captions > Recognise, select a language, and generate captions.
localized_statement.es-ES: En CapCut Web, elige Auto Captions > Recognise, selecciona un idioma y genera subtítulos.

facts.source_quote: Select "Auto Captions" → "Recognise". ... Choose language and click "Generate".
facts.source_title: How do I recognise subtitles? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: These are CapCut Web steps from the help page; interface labels may vary by version or region.

facts.statement: CapCut recommends reviewing auto-generated subtitles and making manual corrections where needed.

localized_statement.en-US: Review auto-generated captions and correct mistakes by hand when needed.
localized_statement.es-ES: Revisa los subtítulos automáticos y corrige manualmente los errores cuando sea necesario.

facts.source_quote: For best results, always review auto-generated subtitles and make manual corrections where needed.
facts.source_title: How do I recognise subtitles? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: This is a review recommendation, not a guarantee that generated captions are error-free.

facts.statement: Unclear, distorted, or noisy audio may prevent CapCut Auto Captions from detecting speech accurately.

localized_statement.en-US: Unclear, distorted, or noisy audio can make automatic caption recognition less reliable.
localized_statement.es-ES: El audio poco claro, distorsionado o con ruido puede dificultar el reconocimiento de subtítulos automáticos.

facts.source_quote: If the audio is unclear, distorted, or full of background noise, CapCut may fail to detect speech accurately.
facts.source_title: Why Aren't Auto Captions Working in CapCut? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: Caption quality depends on the source audio; review generated text before use.

facts.statement: Choosing the wrong language in Auto Captions can result in missing captions or incorrect transcription.

localized_statement.en-US: A wrong language setting can produce no captions or an incorrect transcript.
localized_statement.es-ES: Elegir un idioma incorrecto puede impedir que aparezcan subtítulos o producir una transcripción errónea.

facts.source_quote: Choosing the wrong language can result in no captions or incorrect transcription.
facts.source_title: Why Aren't Auto Captions Working in CapCut? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: Select a supported language matching the spoken audio; available languages may vary.

facts.statement: In CapCut Desktop's bilingual subtitle workflow, users select a target language and click Generate.

localized_statement.en-US: On Desktop, select the target language and click Generate for bilingual subtitles.
localized_statement.es-ES: En la versión de escritorio, selecciona el idioma de destino y pulsa Generate para crear subtítulos bilingües.

facts.source_quote: Select the target language you want, then Click "Generate" to generate bilingual subtitles automatically
facts.source_title: How to Recognize Bilingual Subtitles? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: The page places these steps under CapCut Desktop; target-language choices may differ by product version or region.

facts.statement: In the CapCut Mobile bilingual subtitle workflow, users choose the target language in the Translate to selector.

localized_statement.en-US: On Mobile, choose the target language in the Translate to selector.
localized_statement.es-ES: En la aplicación móvil, elige el idioma de destino en la opción Translate to.

facts.source_quote: Select the target language you want to translate to in "Translate to".
facts.source_title: How to Recognize Bilingual Subtitles? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: The page places this selector under CapCut Mobile; interface wording and languages may vary.

facts.statement: CapCut Text-to-Speech works on text layers and cannot generate audio if no text is selected.

localized_statement.en-US: Select a text layer before generating text-to-speech audio.
localized_statement.es-ES: Selecciona una capa de texto antes de generar audio con texto a voz.

facts.source_quote: TTS only works on text layers. If no text is selected, it won't generate audio.
facts.source_title: Why Is the Text-to-Speech Feature Not Working in CapCut? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: This is a setup condition described in CapCut's help page.

facts.statement: CapCut Text-to-Speech uses cloud processing, so an unstable connection can interrupt generation.

localized_statement.en-US: Text-to-speech uses cloud processing, and an unstable connection can interrupt generation.
localized_statement.es-ES: La función de texto a voz usa procesamiento en la nube; una conexión inestable puede interrumpir la generación.

facts.source_quote: Text-to-Speech relies on cloud processing, so a weak or unstable connection can interrupt generation.
facts.source_title: Why Is the Text-to-Speech Feature Not Working in CapCut? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: Connection quality may affect generation; the page does not promise offline processing.

facts.statement: CapCut Text-to-Speech generation may fail when the selected language or voice is unsupported.

localized_statement.en-US: An unsupported voice or language can cause text-to-speech generation to fail.
localized_statement.es-ES: Una voz o un idioma no compatible puede impedir la generación de audio con texto a voz.

facts.source_quote: If the selected language or voice is not supported, the feature may fail.
facts.source_title: Why Is the Text-to-Speech Feature Not Working in CapCut? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: Available language and voice options depend on the current product offering.

facts.statement: Some CapCut Text-to-Speech voice options roll out gradually and may not be available on every account.

localized_statement.en-US: Some voice options are released gradually and may be missing from an account.
localized_statement.es-ES: Algunas voces se habilitan gradualmente y pueden no aparecer en determinadas cuentas.

facts.source_quote: Certain voice options being rolled out gradually and not yet available on all accounts.
facts.source_title: Why are some voice options in Text to Speech and AI Video Maker on CapCut missing or unavailable? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: The help page also names maintenance and outdated versions as possible causes of missing voices.

facts.statement: CapCut supports batch editing recognized subtitles across multiple clips.

localized_statement.en-US: Batch edit recognized subtitles across multiple clips in CapCut.
localized_statement.es-ES: Edita por lotes los subtítulos reconocidos de varios clips en CapCut.

facts.source_quote: CapCut allows you to batch edit recognized subtitles or lyrics ... across multiple clips at once
facts.source_title: How Should I Batch Edit to Recognize Subtitle/Lyrics Text in CapCut? | CapCut
facts.availability_note: The help page describes workflows for Web, Desktop, and Mobile; controls can vary by version.
